narration:1:1611038001:0.text: After Gervan, Cyran, and Durella leave, you step out from behind the curtain.
narration:1:1611038001:0.source_cn: 格墨文、迪尔格雷和杜瑞拉三人离开之后，你从窗帘后现身
narration:1:1611038001:0.male: After Gervan, Cyran, and Durella leave, you step out from behind the curtain.
narration:1:1611038001:0.female: After Gervan, Cyran, and Durella leave, you step out from behind the curtain.

say:2:1611038002:0.text: Silven's plan didn't work... but he gave it his best shot.
say:2:1611038002:0.source_cn: 休的尝试失败了……他已经尽力了。
say:2:1611038002:0.male: Silven's plan didn't work... but he gave it his best shot.
say:2:1611038002:0.female: Silven's plan didn't work... but he gave it his best shot.

say:3:1611038003:0.text: Like you heard, without solid proof that Gervan's legs are healed, and with all that pressure from different factions, I had to let him go.
say:3:1611038003:0.source_cn: 你刚才也听到，没有格墨文腿伤痊愈的实质证据，迫于几方压...
say:3:1611038003:0.male: Like you heard, without solid proof that Gervan's legs are healed, and with all that pressure from different factions, I had to let him go.
say:3:1611038003:0.female: Like you heard, without solid proof that Gervan's legs are healed, and with all that pressure from different factions, I had to let him go.

say:6:1611038005:0.text: You're thinking of forcing him to reveal his healed legs during the final match?
say:6:1611038005:0.source_cn: 你想在最后的决赛中逼他暴露出腿伤的秘密，当场抓住他？
say:6:1611038005:0.male: You're thinking of forcing him to reveal his healed legs during the final match?
say:6:1611038005:0.female: You're thinking of forcing him to reveal his healed legs during the final match?

say:7:1611038006:0.text: Not a bad strategy. If we're lucky, we might even flush out whoever's backing him. But it's risky. One small mistake, and this whole thing falls apart.
say:7:1611038006:0.source_cn: 这的确是个不错的办法，运气好的话，还能牵出他背后之人。...
say:7:1611038006:0.male: Not a bad strategy. If we're lucky, we might even flush out whoever's backing him. But it's risky. One small mistake, and this whole thing falls apart.
say:7:1611038006:0.female: Not a bad strategy. If we're lucky, we might even flush out whoever's backing him. But it's risky. One small mistake, and this whole thing falls apart.

say:8:1611038007:0.text: If you're going through with this, you'll need to get ahead of everyone else. Find Merlin's hidden tower before anyone else and get inside first.
say:8:1611038007:0.source_cn: 如果你想要这么做的话，最好能抢占先机——比其他人都先找...
say:8:1611038007:0.male: If you're going through with this, you'll need to get ahead of everyone else. Find Merlin's hidden tower before anyone else and get inside first.
say:8:1611038007:0.female: If you're going through with this, you'll need to get ahead of everyone else. Find Merlin's hidden tower before anyone else and get inside first.

say:9:1611038008:0.text: That way, you can learn the layout and have more time to put your plan into motion.
say:9:1611038008:0.source_cn: 这样你才能更早熟悉场地，更从容，也有更多的时间去执行自...
say:9:1611038008:0.male: That way, you can learn the layout and have more time to put your plan into motion.
say:9:1611038008:0.female: That way, you can learn the layout and have more time to put your plan into motion.

say:11:1611038009:0.text: Trying to find your own magic tower... ironic, isn't it? But what else can you do with that memory of yours?
say:11:1611038009:0.source_cn: 想办法找到自己的魔法塔——这听起来像是个笑话，但没办法...
say:11:1611038009:0.male: Trying to find your own magic tower... ironic, isn't it? But what else can you do with that memory of yours?
say:11:1611038009:0.female: Trying to find your own magic tower... ironic, isn't it? But what else can you do with that memory of yours?

say:12:1611038010:0.text: You should ask someone who knows the tower... Zorya, or Contess maybe? Guess it's time to head back to the <style="highlight">library lounge</style>.
say:12:1611038010:0.source_cn: 该去问问熟悉你的魔法塔的人……佐尔娅，或许还有康缇丝？...
